av_feeder.label: Shared autonomous feeder to Bukit Chagar
av_feeder.precedent: LTA opened autonomous shuttle services in Punggol to the public on 1 April 2026; the draft Johor Bahru Local Plan 2035 proposes autonomous rapid transit corridors centred on Bukit Chagar (alignment not confirmed).

parking_to_proximity.label: Parking to Proximity
parking_to_proximity.literature: International Transport Forum (2015), "Urban Mobility System Upgrade: How shared self-driving cars could change city traffic" — modelled for Lisbon that a shared self-driving fleet could remove all on-street parking.
